title: Modularity of elliptic curves over imaginary quadratic fields

result.label: Modularity of elliptic curves over imaginary quadratic fields
result.statement: Proves the modularity conjecture for elliptic curves over imaginary quadratic fields: every elliptic curve over every imaginary quadratic field is modular, with matching local parameters at every place.
result.roleNote: The family's stated result in the release.
